definition_es: Un repositorio centralizado que almacena datos en su forma natural sin procesamiento previo, permitiendo análisis flexible.
definition_en: A centralized repository storing raw data in its natural form without prior processing, enabling flexible analytics.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Proceso de Extracción, Transformación y Carga de datos desde fuentes a destinos, limpiando e integrando durante el camino.
definition_en: Extract, Transform, Load process for moving data from sources to destinations while cleaning and integrating.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: División de datos en subconjuntos lógicos según criterios (fecha, región, etc.) para mejorar rendimiento de consultas.
definition_en: Dividing data into logical subsets based on criteria (date, region) to improve query performance.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Estructura o definición de cómo están organizados los datos (tipos, campos, relaciones) en una base de datos o tabla.
definition_en: Structure or definition of how data is organized (types, fields, relationships) in a database or table.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Proceso de selección, creación y transformación de características para mejorar el rendimiento del modelo ML.
definition_en: Process of selecting, creating, and transforming features to improve ML model performance.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Configuración de algoritmo ML que se establece antes del entrenamiento (learning rate, batch size, etc.), no se aprende de datos.
definition_en: ML algorithm configuration set before training (learning rate, batch size) that is not learned from data.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Degradación del rendimiento del modelo en producción debido a cambios en distribución de datos o comportamiento del usuario.
definition_en: Model performance degradation in production due to data distribution changes or user behavior shifts.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Proceso de usar un modelo ML entrenado para hacer predicciones en datos nuevos no vistos durante entrenamiento.
definition_en: Process of using a trained ML model to make predictions on new unseen data.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: URL o interfaz de acceso a un modelo ML desplegado en SageMaker que recibe solicitudes y devuelve predicciones.
definition_en: URL or interface to access a deployed SageMaker ML model that receives requests and returns predictions.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Servicio AWS completamente gestionado para construir, entrenar y desplegar modelos de machine learning a escala.
definition_en: AWS fully managed service for building, training, and deploying machine learning models at scale.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Sesgo sistemático en predicciones del modelo que favorece ciertos grupos sobre otros, afectando equidad.
definition_en: Systematic bias in model predictions favoring certain groups, affecting fairness and equity.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Técnica de validación que divide datos en múltiples partes para entrenar y evaluar el modelo múltiples veces.
definition_en: Validation technique dividing data into multiple parts to train and evaluate models multiple times.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Cuando un modelo memoriza datos de entrenamiento incluyendo ruido, perdiendo capacidad de generalización en datos nuevos.
definition_en: When a model memorizes training data including noise, losing generalization ability on new data.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Cuando un modelo es demasiado simple para capturar patrones subyacentes en los datos, mostrando bajo rendimiento.
definition_en: When a model is too simple to capture underlying patterns in data, showing poor performance.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Gráfico que muestra la relación entre tasa de verdaderos positivos y falsos positivos a diferentes umbrales de clasificación.
definition_en: Graph showing relationship between true positive rate and false positive rate at different classification thresholds.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Tabla que resume el desempeño de un clasificador comparando valores predichos vs. valores reales.
definition_en: Table summarizing classifier performance comparing predicted vs. actual values.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Servicio de SageMaker que procesa múltiples registros en lotes para inferencia sin requerir un endpoint siempre activo.
definition_en: SageMaker service processing multiple records in batches for inference without a running endpoint.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Método experimental que compara dos versiones de modelo (A y B) en tráfico real para determinar cuál es mejor.
definition_en: Experimental method comparing two model versions (A and B) on real traffic to determine which performs better.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Estrategia de despliegue que envía nuevo modelo a pequeño % de tráfico primero, escalando si es exitoso, reduciendo riesgo.
definition_en: Deployment strategy routing new model to small traffic %, scaling if successful, reducing risk.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Empaquetado estandarizado de aplicación con todas sus dependencias usando Docker, asegurando consistencia entre ambientes.
definition_en: Standardized packaging of application with all dependencies using Docker, ensuring consistency across environments.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Amazon Elastic Container Registry, servicio para almacenar, gestionar y desplegar imágenes Docker en AWS.
definition_en: Amazon Elastic Container Registry for storing, managing, and deploying Docker container images on AWS.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Observación continua de métricas y comportamiento de modelos en producción para detectar degradación tempranamente.
definition_en: Continuous observation of metrics and model behavior in production to detect degradation early.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Cambio en la distribución o características de datos en producción comparado con datos de entrenamiento.
definition_en: Change in distribution or characteristics of production data compared to training data.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Cambio en distribución de predicciones del modelo a lo largo del tiempo en producción.
definition_en: Change in distribution of model predictions over time in production.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Repositorio centralizado que almacena y gestiona características pre-calculadas para reutilización en múltiples modelos.
definition_en: Centralized repository storing and managing pre-calculated features for reuse across multiple models.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Flujo automatizado secuencial que integra datos, entrenamiento, validación y despliegue de modelos ML.
definition_en: Automated sequential workflow integrating data, training, validation, and deployment of ML models.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Prácticas y herramientas para operacionalizar ML, asegurando calidad, eficiencia y reproducibilidad en ciclo de vida.
definition_en: Practices and tools to operationalize ML, ensuring quality, efficiency, and reproducibility throughout lifecycle.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Root Mean Square Error, métrica de error que calcula raíz cuadrada del promedio de errores al cuadrado.
definition_en: Root Mean Square Error metric calculating square root of average squared errors.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Métrica que balancea precisión y recall, útil para problemas desbalanceados donde ambas métricas importan.
definition_en: Metric balancing precision and recall, useful for imbalanced problems where both metrics matter.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide

definition_es: Métrica que mide % de predicciones positivas que fueron correctas, importante cuando falsos positivos son costosos.
definition_en: Metric measuring % of positive predictions that were correct, important when false positives are costly.
source: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) Exam Guide
